title: REST deprecation work item 3: policies and tool approvals
intent: Remove REST mutation endpoints for policy CRUD/evaluation and tool approval/rejection because those mutations are handled by signed Nostr control-plane events.
observed_behavior_before: router.go registered POST /policies, PUT /policies/{id}, DELETE /policies/{id}, POST /policies/evaluate, POST /tools/{id}/approve, and POST /tools/{id}/reject.
PolicyHandler and ToolHandler accepted direct REST mutation calls for those operations.
intended_behavior: The six Work Item 3 REST mutation routes are unavailable.
Policy read routes remain available for projected state.
Tool pending/read routes and tool denylist keep-section endpoints remain available.
Public client policy creation fails before network calls with signer-first Nostr guidance.
Nostr reactor handling for policy and tool approval events remains unchanged.
out_of_scope: Deleting policy or tool domain/service/repository types used by Nostr reactor and read paths.
Removing tool denylist endpoints, which are listed in the KEEP section.
Rewriting CLI or MCP mutation surfaces to publish signed Nostr events; tracked by bahia-pbjq.
